lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Tanya Romano is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Tanya is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d40: 🕯️ Tanya Romano is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Tanya kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Tanya's gone." Aidan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Tanya." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Zuri blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d40: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Tanya Romano, 40 days. The mantle passes to Zuri Simpson.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Zuri Simpson, 48 — an HVAC tech. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Echo Location, War Cry, Green Thumb, Literally.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Tanya — and Tanya is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Ellie, Aidan, Jada and 4 more speak for Zuri — "Tanya trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Zuri before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
